summary: In October 2026 a Chinese-speaking attacker used open-source Cairn AI agents to attack more than 1,200 websites at over 100 companies, and the attacker's own records, found by NorForge researcher Snorre Fagerland on exposed control panels, named Cummins among the targets. Cummins said it was investigating a report of a possible attack on a website run by one of its vendors; no compromise or data theft was confirmed.
